summary: Wayne County lookout listed at 61 ft on a Georgia towers list; no source gives its build date, staffing, fate or present site.

evidence.supports: Georgia list names a broadhurst lookout in Wayne County
Position 31.459 N, 81.921 W and elevation 61 ft (18.6 m)
The list is of Georgia lookout towers
Eastern US Lookouts page for Broadhurst gives only the county
NHLR Georgia index lists 29 registered lookouts, none named Broadhurst
evidence.quote: There are 29 lookouts registered in Georgia.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Sources are one row in the Georgia towers list, a county-only Eastern US Lookouts page, and the NHLR Georgia index, which does not name it. The story is about 105 words, below the 120-word target, because nothing else was found; I did not pad it. The brief has no agency, status or access and none is added. Not checked: whether the Eastern JESUP row (Wayne County, a separate entry) is being confused with this site. A July 2026 Watch Duty fire on Broadhurst Road is a road-named wildfire, not evidence about the tower, and is not used. Worth holding for a county or Georgia Forestry Commission history source before publication. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the Eastern page holds only the county (its text ends with 'broadhurst' and 'Wayne County'), and none of the 29 NHLR Georgia names is Broadhurst. The Georgia list prints no unit for elevation; feet is inferred from its Brasstown row (4735, which cannot be metres in Georgia) and matches TopoZone's feet figure for Butts.
